ios.desc:
In this barren world of flat design and antialiased text, don't you long for crisp lines and just 16 well-chosen colours?  We certainly do.  Rustling Broccoli presents a world first on your pocket computer: Solitaire for Workgroups, like the one grandma used to play.  Don't get distracted by notifications, ads, or "Dark Mode", just stick to one purpose: putting all the cards in the foundation piles.  The only advantage of this game over the real deal original back in the nineties is that you can stick it in your pocket and take it with you.

Featuring:

- a snazzy mouse pointer
- original Installation Wizard
- all the animated card backs you know and love
- certainly no ads
- definitely no tracking, analytics, or any other invasions of privacy
- many cool hidden surprises that will wow you and your grandma

This is the game for you.  Download it now.  Also, eat your leafy greens.

quotes.text:
This might be something y'all find amusing.  My partner and i created a Solitaire clone for iOS, in a weird trippy mishmash of Windows 95 and Windows 3.11 visuals, including a lot of artistic licence for easter eggs.  Everything is lovingly pixellated, and the end game animation, well, we find it quite satisfying.

Featuring all the original card backs you know and love, no ads, no analytics, no nasties, and artisanally extracted bitmaps from the original cards.dll!  It's perpetually free of charge to play.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sol-exe-retro-solitaire/id1542164345#?platform=iphone
